parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the movable switch part of the electrical switch assembly, made of durable plastic material.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the actuator that toggles the electrical connection on or off when pressed or flipped.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly or rotationally depending on the switch design, allowing user input to change the circuit state.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the switch, typically made of insulating plastic to house internal contacts and support the actuator.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and insulation for the internal electrical components, ensuring safe operation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation, serving as the fixed housing for the switch mechanism.
